# Execution quality: TCA dashboard
**Variables:** `@day` is the session analysed (TICK string, e.g. `'2026-11-11'` or `'$yesterday'`). `@hist` is the wider window used for counterparty evidence, which is too thin for one day (e.g. `'$today-3d..$yesterday'`).

**Conventions:** markout = side-signed (mid − fill price) / price, in bps. **Positive = the market moved in our favour.** Aggressive fills should sit near −half-spread at 0 and recover; passive fills should sit near +half-spread and *hold* it. A passive curve that falls below 0 after the fill means we're being picked off. Exchange fills are measured against their own venue's book (`energy_quotes.source = venue`). Broker/OTC trades are measured against the primary venue (ICE_ENDEX for TTF/EUA, CME for WTI, ICE for the rest), at `trade_ts`, not `booked_ts`.

**11 Nov 2026 in one line:** exchange execution is clean, with no sign of pick-off on any venue or in either liquidity type. The adverse selection is in voice/OTC flow with **INDUSTRIAL** counterparties (and, more weakly, UTILITY). Big strip "slippage" is stale quotes, not bad fills. The 09:30–09:50 gas move is market risk, not execution.
cells.name: Read me

cells.value:
WITH m AS (SELECT t.venue, t.passive, h.offset / 1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec, count() n,
 avg(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS mo,
 stddev_samp(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS sd,
 avg((q.ask-q.bid)/((q.bid+q.ask)/2)*10000)/2 AS hs
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 30s, 5m) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day)
SELECT venue, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS liquidity, n AS fills,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN hs END), 2) AS half_spread_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_0s_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 30 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_30s_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_5m_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mo / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_5m
FROM m GROUP BY venue, passive, n ORDER BY venue, liquidity
cells.name: Exchange fills: venue × liquidity scorecard (@day)

cells.value:
WITH m AS (SELECT t.book, t.passive, h.offset / 1_000_000_000 AS horizon_sec,
 avg(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS mo
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (-60s, -10s, 0, 1s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 300s, 900s) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day)
SELECT CASE horizon_sec WHEN -60 THEN 'a: -1m' WHEN -10 THEN 'b: -10s' WHEN 0 THEN 'c: 0' WHEN 1 THEN 'd: +1s' WHEN 10 THEN 'e: +10s' WHEN 30 THEN 'f: +30s' WHEN 60 THEN 'g: +1m' WHEN 300 THEN 'h: +5m' ELSE 'i: +15m' END AS hz,
 book || CASE WHEN passive THEN ' passive' ELSE ' aggr' END AS series, round(mo, 2) AS markout_bps
FROM m ORDER BY hz, series
cells.name: Exchange markout curve by book (bps, @day)

WITH f AS ((SELECT trade_ts, left(counterparty, length(counterparty) - 3) AS cp_type, symbol, qty, px,
   CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 'ICE_ENDEX' WHEN curve = 'WTI' THEN 'CME' ELSE 'ICE' END AS src
  FROM (energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts IN @hist LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
  WHERE channel != 'EXCH' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts IN @hist ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)),
m AS (SELECT t.cp_type, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_sec,
  avg(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS mo
 FROM f t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.src = q.source)
 LIST (-1800s, -300s, 0, 60s, 300s, 900s, 1800s, 3600s) AS h)
SELECT CASE horizon_sec WHEN -1800 THEN 'a: -30m' WHEN -300 THEN 'b: -5m' WHEN 0 THEN 'c: 0' WHEN 60 THEN 'd: +1m' WHEN 300 THEN 'e: +5m' WHEN 900 THEN 'f: +15m' WHEN 1800 THEN 'g: +30m' ELSE 'h: +60m' END AS hz,
 cp_type, round(mo, 2) AS markout_bps FROM m ORDER BY hz, cp_type
cells.name: Broker/OTC markout by counterparty type (bps, @hist)

cells.value:
WITH f AS ((SELECT trade_ts, left(counterparty, length(counterparty) - 3) AS cp_type, timestamp_floor('d', trade_ts) AS trade_day, symbol, qty, px,
   CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 'ICE_ENDEX' WHEN curve = 'WTI' THEN 'CME' ELSE 'ICE' END AS src
  FROM (energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts IN @hist LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
  WHERE channel != 'EXCH' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts IN @hist ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)),
m AS (SELECT t.cp_type, t.trade_day, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_sec, count() AS n,
  avg(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS mo,
  stddev_samp(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS sd
 FROM f t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.src = q.source)
 LIST (300s, 1800s) AS h)
SELECT cp_type AS counterparty_type, trade_day, n AS trades,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_5m_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_30m_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN mo / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_30m
FROM m GROUP BY cp_type, trade_day, n ORDER BY counterparty_type, trade_day
cells.name: Counterparty type × day: is it persistent? (@hist)

WITH f AS ((SELECT trade_ts, left(counterparty, length(counterparty) - 3) AS cp_type, symbol, qty, px,
   CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 'ICE_ENDEX' WHEN curve = 'WTI' THEN 'CME' ELSE 'ICE' END AS src
  FROM (energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts IN @hist LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
  WHERE channel != 'EXCH' AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts IN @day ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)),
s AS (SELECT t.cp_type, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_sec, count() AS n, sum(abs(t.qty) * t.px) AS notl,
  sum(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) * abs(t.qty)) AS pnl,
  sum(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS sum_bps
 FROM f t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.src = q.source)
 LIST (0, 300s, 1800s) AS h),
c AS (SELECT s.cp_type, s.horizon_sec, sum(s.n) AS n, sum(s.notl * x.factor) AS notl_usd, sum(s.pnl * x.factor) AS pnl_usd,
  sum(s.sum_bps) / sum(s.n) AS mo
 FROM s JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof x ON s.symbol = x.symbol GROUP BY s.cp_type, s.horizon_sec)
SELECT cp_type AS counterparty_type, n AS trades, round(notl_usd / 1e6, 1) AS notional_musd,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_0_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_5m_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN mo END), 2) AS markout_30m_bps,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS pnl_0_usd,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS pnl_5m_usd,
 round(max(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS pnl_30m_usd
FROM c GROUP BY cp_type, n, notl_usd ORDER BY markout_30m_bps
cells.name: Broker/OTC by counterparty type: size and USD P&L (@day)

SELECT ts, symbol, round((close / first_value(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY ts) - 1) * 100, 2) AS pct_from_open
FROM energy_quotes_1m
WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol IN ('NBP_Dec-26','TTF_Dec-26','UKPWR_Dec-26','JKM_Dec-26','BRENT_Jan-27','WTI_Dec-26')
ORDER BY ts
cells.name: Front months: % move from day open (@day): the 09:30 gas move

WITH x AS (SELECT t.symbol, (t.ts - q.ts::timestamp_ns) / 1e9 AS quote_age_s,
  abs((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 AS dist_mid_bps, (q.ask-q.bid) / ((q.bid+q.ask)/2) * 10000 / 2 AS hs_bps
 FROM energy_fills t ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
 WHERE t.ts IN @day)
SELECT CASE i.granularity WHEN 'M' THEN 'Month' WHEN 'Q' THEN 'Quarter' WHEN 'S' THEN 'Season' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Cal year' WHEN 'Z' THEN 'Dec contract (carbon)' ELSE i.granularity END AS tenor_type,
 count() AS fills, round(percentile_cont(x.quote_age_s, 0.5), 2) AS median_quote_age_s, round(max(x.quote_age_s)) AS max_quote_age_s,
 round(avg(x.dist_mid_bps - x.hs_bps), 2) AS avg_excess_vs_half_spread_bps,
 sum((x.dist_mid_bps > x.hs_bps + 3)::int) AS fills_off_by_3bps_plus,
 round(100.0 * sum((x.dist_mid_bps > x.hs_bps + 3)::int) / count(), 1) AS pct_off
FROM x JOIN energy_instruments i ON x.symbol = i.symbol GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY fills DESC
cells.name: Strip fills vs stale quotes: benchmark problem, not execution (@day)

WITH e AS (SELECT trade_id, channel, status, reason, version, booked_ts, trade_ts FROM energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts IN @hist AND trade_ts IN @day),
v AS (SELECT trade_id, channel, sum((status = 'CANCELLED')::int) AS cancels, sum((reason = 'DUPLICATE')::int) AS dups,
  sum((status = 'AMENDED')::int) AS amends, min(datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts)) AS first_lag_s FROM e GROUP BY trade_id, channel)
SELECT channel, count() AS trades, sum(amends) AS amendments, sum(cancels) AS cancellations, sum(dups) AS cancelled_as_duplicate,
 round(avg(first_lag_s) / 60.0, 1) AS avg_booking_lag_min, round(max(first_lag_s) / 60.0, 1) AS max_booking_lag_min
FROM v ORDER BY channel
cells.name: Booking hygiene by channel (@day trades)

cells.value:
SELECT t.ts, t.symbol, t.venue, t.trader, t.passive, t.qty, t.px, q.bid, q.ask,
 round((t.ts - q.ts::timestamp_ns) / 1e9, 1) AS quote_age_s,
 round(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000, 1) AS markout_0_bps
FROM energy_fills t ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND abs((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 > 8
ORDER BY t.ts
cells.name: Fills more than 8 bps from venue mid, with quote age (@day)
